sentences.text: Researchers reported a case of a 13-month-old girl with a bleeding tumor in her left parietal region that exhibited embryonal-like traits, including high cell density and widespread nuclear expression of the BCOR protein.

Although initial targeted RT-PCR and panel-based genomic tests failed to identify the mutation, follow-up whole-genome and RNA sequencing confirmed an in-frame duplication of 126 base pairs in exon 15 of the BCOR gene.
The authors noted that after complete surgical removal and multimodal therapy, the patient remained free of disease progression for 18 months.
